profile.description: Oil Terminal S.A. operates as an oil terminal in Southeastern Europe. It offers services for the reception, loading, and unloading of crude oil, petroleum products, petrochemicals, and liquid chemicals, as well as other finished products or liquid raw materials for import, export, and transit. The company was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Constanta, Romania.
